blockers.title: Promote GT endpoints before computing the float64 nearest-candidate rule
blockers.finding: The empty-geometric-mask branch computes size and center using the incoming float32 GT, then casts those rounded derived values to double. This does not implement the specified float64 size-normalized-center ranking. It can create a spurious tie and choose a different native anchor, changing the GT-conditioned loss, input-risk gradient and conditional W on that branch.

reproduction.kind: Read-only IEEE754 arithmetic counterexample; no detector, GPU or experiment executed
reproduction.precondition: Native geometric candidate mask is empty, the explicitly supported nearest-candidate branch
reproduction.y_note: The two anchors share y, so their y-distance contributions are equal and cannot change this ordering.

blockers.precise_fix: In the empty-mask branch, convert the actual GT endpoints to float64 FIRST, then compute both size64 = box64[2:] - box64[:2] and center64 = (box64[:2] + box64[2:]) / 2; compute distance from float64 anchors using only those values. Retain the no-epsilon, unchanged-GT, native-index argmin tie policy.
blockers.closure_required: Exercise the actual risk_candidate_mask helper with the stated noncentral box and an explicitly empty geometric mask; expect [false,true]. Retain the exact-center tie test expecting the lowest native index and invalid-box tests. Commit the fix, verify source-to-selection evidence and rerun the relevant current-commit bounded CUDA production smoke because a scientific sink changed. The main agent records blocker-to-fix-to-evidence closure; no second or closing scientific reviewer is required.
blockers.impact_limit: The measured real failed backpack used five native geometric candidates, so this counterexample does not invalidate its measured loss/gradient or assert that the eight-image probe encountered this nearest branch. Population frequency and impact of the branch are unmeasured.
